description.value: Campbell River Whale Watching and Adventure Tours is a carbon-neutral eco-tour company that has operated from the E-dock at Campbell River harbour since 2008, offering whale watching, grizzly bear, kayaking, eagle, and ocean rapids tours throughout Discovery Passage and surrounding waters. The company has grown to a fleet of seven vessels and is northern Vancouver Island's first carbon-neutral eco-tour operator. They hold Rainbow Registered accreditation as the first whale watching company in Canada to receive it, and partner with First Nations on grizzly bear tours that include cultural interpretation.
